description: List the public data APIs, optionally filtered by a search term. Returns each API id, what it covers, its query parameters, up to 3 real sample records (current data, free to inspect before getting a key or paying), and its dashboard link. If nothing matches, we start building an API for your search right away and return building.request_id: it is usually ready in 5 to 10 minutes (check_request).

notify_url.description: Optional public https webhook: if nothing matches we build it and POST a signed api_ready message when it is live.

query.description: Optional search text, e.g. "recall" or "drug shortage".

name: search_apis
title: Search the API directory
